scope: Independent source-pixel inventory for one figure, not a source-page or course approval.

independence.inventoryDerivedFrom: Original PNG pixels only; review criteria in the user request are not treated as pixel evidence.

inventory.observation: One unlabelled black-on-white circuit illustration, with a winding on the left, two separated plate shapes on the right, and top and bottom connecting wires in a common frame.

The left winding has three visibly repeated oval turns stacked vertically. The curved winding and its upper and lower tails join the top and bottom wires. The repeated forms are hand-drawn and irregular.
requirements: upper and lower coil terminals connected to their respective wires

inventory.observation: Two roughly horizontal, wide plate shapes are vertically stacked on the right. Their hand-drawn polygonal outlines suggest plate depth. White separation remains between the upper and lower plates; no conductor crosses this separation. The upper wire meets the upper plate, and the lower plate meets the lower wire.
requirements: upper wire terminates at upper plate
lower wire starts at lower plate

inventory.observation: Tracing clockwise from the upper coil terminal follows the upper-left elbow, top horizontal wire, upper-right downward wire, and upper plate. The trace stops at the capacitor gap. Starting at the lower plate continues downward, left across the bottom wire, and upward through the coil to the initial terminal. There is no break in the wires or winding away from the capacitor gap.
requirements: only capacitor gap interrupts galvanic trace
inventory.clarification: Clockwise describes the review trace, not an indicated current direction or motion in the source.

inventory.observation: No battery, source/generator, switch, resistor, connection dot, polarity sign, arrow, point name, component label, number, unit, or caption is visible. There is no grid, table, axis, quantitative scale, or second subfigure.
requirements: do not introduce labels, arrows, polarity or quantitative data

sourceFactsVersusInterpretation.pixelFacts: Three winding turns; two separated plates; shared upper and lower wire paths; no labels or extra components.
